67:1.ar: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرٌ
67:1.en: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent

67:2.ar: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلࣰ اۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ
67:2.en: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving

67:3.ar: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ اۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتࣲۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورࣲ‏
67:3.en: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks

67:4.ar: ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئࣰ ا وَهُوَ حَسِيرࣱ‏
67:4.en: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued

67:5.ar: وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا رُجُومࣰ ا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
67:5.en: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze

67:6.ar: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
67:6.en: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination

67:7.ar: إِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقࣰ ا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ
67:7.en: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up

67:8.ar: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجࣱ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرࣱ‏
67:8.en: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner

67:9.ar: قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرࣱ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ كَبِيرࣲ‏
67:9.en: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error

67:10.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ أَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
67:10.en: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze

67:11.ar: فَٱعۡتَرَفُواْ بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسُحۡقࣰ ا لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
67:11.en: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze

67:12.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةࣱ وَأَجۡرࣱ كَبِيرࣱ‏
67:12.en: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward

67:13.ar: وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
67:13.en: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts

67:14.ar: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
67:14.en: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted

67:15.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ ذَلُولࣰ ا فَٱمۡشُواْ فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِهِۦۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
67:15.en: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection

67:16.ar: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ
67:16.en: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway

67:17.ar: أَمۡ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبࣰ اۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيرِ
67:17.en: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning

67:18.ar: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
67:18.en: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach

67:19.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صَٰٓفَّٰتࣲ وَيَقۡبِضۡنَۚ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءِۭ بَصِيرٌ
67:19.en: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing

67:20.ar: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ جُندࣱ لَّكُمۡ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ إِنِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ
67:20.en: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion

67:21.ar: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَرۡزُقُكُمۡ إِنۡ أَمۡسَكَ رِزۡقَهُۥۚ بَل لَّجُّواْ فِي عُتُوࣲّ وَنُفُورٍ
67:21.en: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion

67:22.ar: أَفَمَن يَمۡشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦٓ أَهۡدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمۡشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
67:22.en: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path

67:23.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
67:23.en: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful

67:24.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ
67:24.en: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered

67:25.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
67:25.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful

67:26.ar: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
67:26.en: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner

67:27.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةࣰ سِيٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
67:27.en: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call

67:28.ar: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَهۡلَكَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوۡ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمࣲ‏
67:28.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment

67:29.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
67:29.en: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error

67:30.ar: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرࣰ ا فَمَن يَأۡتِيكُم بِمَآءࣲ مَّعِينِۭ
67:30.en: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water

68:1.en: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe

68:2.en: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman

68:3.en: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted

68:4.en: And indeed, you are of a great moral character

68:5.en: So you will see and they will see

68:6.en: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil]

68:7.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
68:7.en: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided

68:8.en: Then do not obey the deniers

68:9.en: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you]

68:10.en: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

68:11.en: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip

68:12.en: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful

68:13.en: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender

68:14.en: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children

68:15.ar: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
68:15.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples

68:16.en: We will brand him upon the snout

68:17.ar: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ
68:17.en: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

68:19.ar: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ
68:19.en: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep

68:20.en: And it became as though reaped

68:21.en: And they called one another at morning

68:22.ar: أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ
68:22.en: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit

68:23.en: So they set out, while lowering their voices

68:24.ar: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينࣱ‏
68:24.en: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person

68:25.en: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able

68:26.en: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost

68:28.ar: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
68:28.en: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]

68:29.ar: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
68:29.en: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers

68:30.en: Then they approached one another, blaming each other

68:31.en: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors

68:32.ar: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
68:32.en: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous

68:33.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
68:33.en: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew

68:34.ar: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
68:34.en: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure

68:35.en: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals

68:36.en: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge

68:37.en: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

68:38.en: That indeed for you is whatever you choose

68:39.ar: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ
68:39.en: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge

68:40.en: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible

68:41.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُ فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
68:41.en: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful

68:42.ar: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقࣲ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
68:42.en: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able

68:43.ar: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةࣱۖ وَقَدۡ كَانُواْ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمۡ سَٰلِمُونَ
68:43.en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound

68:44.ar: فَذَرۡنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِۖ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
68:44.en: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know

68:45.en: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm

68:46.ar: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
68:46.en: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down

68:47.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down

68:48.ar: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومࣱ‏
68:48.en: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed

68:49.ar: لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومࣱ‏
68:49.en: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured

68:50.en: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous

68:51.ar: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏
68:51.en: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad

68:52.en: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds

69:3.en: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality

69:4.en: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity

69:5.en: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]

69:6.ar: وَأَمَّا عَادࣱ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِرِيحࣲ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةࣲ‏
69:6.en: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind

69:7.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالࣲ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومࣰ اۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةࣲ‏
69:7.en: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees

69:8.en: Then do you see of them any remains

69:9.ar: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَن قَبۡلَهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلۡخَاطِئَةِ
69:9.en: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin

69:10.ar: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةࣰ رَّابِيَةً
69:10.en: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity]

69:11.ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ
69:11.en: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship

69:12.ar: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةࣰ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنࣱ وَٰعِيَةࣱ‏
69:12.en: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it

69:13.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ نَفۡخَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ‏
69:13.en: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

69:14.ar: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ‏
69:14.en: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow

69:15.en: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur

69:16.en: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm

69:17.ar: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَاۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ ثَمَٰنِيَةࣱ‏
69:17.en: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them]

69:18.ar: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ تُعۡرَضُونَ لَا تَخۡفَىٰ مِنكُمۡ خَافِيَةࣱ‏
69:18.en: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed

69:19.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
69:19.en: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record

69:20.en: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account

69:21.en: So he will be in a pleasant life

69:23.en: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near

69:24.ar: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَيَّامِ ٱلۡخَالِيَةِ
69:24.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past

69:25.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
69:25.en: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

69:26.en: And had not known what is my account

69:27.en: I wish my death had been the decisive one

69:28.en: My wealth has not availed me

69:29.en: Gone from me is my authority

69:30.en: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him

69:32.ar: ثُمَّ فِي سِلۡسِلَةࣲ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعࣰ ا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ
69:32.en: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him

69:33.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
69:33.en: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great

69:34.en: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor

69:35.en: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

69:36.en: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds

69:37.en: None will eat it except the sinners

69:38.en: So I swear by what you see

69:39.en: And what you do not see

69:40.en: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger

69:41.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُونَ
69:41.en: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe

69:42.ar: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
69:42.en: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember

69:43.en: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds

69:44.en: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings

69:45.en: We would have seized him by the right hand

69:46.en: Then We would have cut from him the aorta

69:47.ar: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
69:47.en: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him

69:48.en: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous

69:49.en: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers

69:50.en: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers

69:51.en: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty

69:52.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great

70:1.en: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen

70:2.en: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer

70:3.en: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent

70:4.ar: تَعۡرُجُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمࣲ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥ خَمۡسِينَ أَلۡفَ سَنَةࣲ‏
70:4.en: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years

70:5.en: So be patient with gracious patience

70:8.en: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil

70:9.en: And the mountains will be like wool

70:10.en: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend

70:11.ar: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمۡۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُ لَوۡ يَفۡتَدِي مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمِئِذِۭ بِبَنِيهِ
70:11.en: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children

70:12.en: And his wife and his brother

70:13.en: And his nearest kindred who shelter him

70:14.ar: وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعࣰ ا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
70:14.en: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him

70:15.en: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell]

70:17.en: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

70:21.en: And when good touches him, withholding [of it]

70:23.en: Those who are constant in their prayer

70:24.en: And those within whose wealth is a known right

70:25.en: For the petitioner and the deprived

70:26.en: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

70:27.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
70:27.en: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord

70:28.en: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe

70:29.en: And those who guard their private parts

70:30.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ
70:30.en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed

70:31.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ
70:31.en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors

70:32.en: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive

70:33.en: And those who are in their testimonies upright

70:34.en: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer

70:35.en: They will be in gardens, honored

70:36.en: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad]

70:37.en: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups

70:38.ar: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمࣲ‏
70:38.en: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure

70:39.en: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know

70:40.ar: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
70:40.en: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able

70:41.ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
70:41.en: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone

70:42.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
70:42.en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised

70:43.ar: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعࣰ ا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبࣲ يُوفِضُونَ
70:43.en: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening

70:44.ar: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةࣱۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
70:44.en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised

71:1.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
71:1.en: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment

71:2.ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
71:2.en: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner

71:3.en: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me

71:4.ar: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۚ لَوۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
71:4.en: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew

71:5.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِي لَيۡلࣰ ا وَنَهَارࣰ ا
71:5.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day

71:6.ar: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيٓ إِلَّا فِرَارࣰ ا
71:6.en: But my invitation increased them not except in flight

71:7.ar: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡشَوۡاْ ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ ٱسۡتِكۡبَارࣰ ا
71:7.en: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance

71:9.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَنتُ لَهُمۡ وَأَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِسۡرَارࣰ ا
71:9.en: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

71:10.ar: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارࣰ ا
71:10.en: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver

71:11.en: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

71:12.ar: وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلࣲ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرࣰ ا
71:12.en: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers

71:13.ar: مَّا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارࣰ ا
71:13.en: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

71:14.en: While He has created you in stages

71:15.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ ا
71:15.en: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

71:16.ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجࣰ ا
71:16.en: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp

71:17.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ نَبَاتࣰ ا
71:17.en: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth

71:18.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمۡ فِيهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجࣰ ا
71:18.en: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction

71:19.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِسَاطࣰ ا
71:19.en: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse

71:20.ar: لِّتَسۡلُكُواْ مِنۡهَا سُبُلࣰ ا فِجَاجࣰ ا
71:20.en: That you may follow therein roads of passage

71:21.ar: قَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارࣰ ا
71:21.en: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss

71:22.en: And they conspired an immense conspiracy

71:23.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدࣰّ ا وَلَا سُوَاعࣰ ا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرࣰ ا
71:23.en: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr

71:24.ar: وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرࣰ اۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلࣰ ا
71:24.en: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error

71:25.ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارࣰ ا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارࣰ ا
71:25.en: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers

71:26.ar: وَقَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
71:26.en: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant

71:27.ar: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرࣰ ا كَفَّارࣰ ا
71:27.en: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever

71:28.ar: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنࣰ ا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا
71:28.en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction

72:1.ar: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبࣰ ا
72:1.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an

72:2.ar: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدࣰ ا
72:2.en: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone

72:3.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةࣰ وَلَا وَلَدࣰ ا
72:3.en: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

72:4.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطࣰ ا
72:4.en: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression

72:5.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ ا
72:5.en: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie

72:6.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقࣰ ا
72:6.en: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden

72:7.ar: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدࣰ ا
72:7.en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger]

72:8.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ ا وَشُهُبࣰ ا
72:8.en: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames

72:9.ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابࣰ ا رَّصَدࣰ ا
72:9.en: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him

72:10.ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدࣰ ا
72:10.en: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course

72:11.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدࣰ ا
72:11.en: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways

72:12.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبࣰ ا
72:12.en: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight

72:13.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسࣰ ا وَلَا رَهَقࣰ ا
72:13.en: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden

72:14.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدࣰ ا
72:14.en: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course

72:15.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبࣰ ا
72:15.en: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood

72:16.ar: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقࣰ ا
72:16.en: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision

72:17.ar: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا صَعَدࣰ ا
72:17.en: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment

72:18.ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣰ ا
72:18.en: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone

72:19.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدࣰ ا
72:19.en: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass

72:20.ar: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدࣰ ا
72:20.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone

72:21.ar: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرࣰّ ا وَلَا رَشَدࣰ ا
72:21.en: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction

72:22.ar: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣱ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا
72:22.en: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge

72:23.ar: إِلَّا بَلَٰغࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
72:23.en: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever

72:24.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرࣰ ا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدࣰ ا
72:24.en: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number

72:25.ar: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبࣱ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا
72:25.en: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period

72:26.ar: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
72:26.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

72:27.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولࣲ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدࣰ ا
72:27.en: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers

72:28.ar: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا
72:28.en: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number

73:1.en: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]

73:2.en: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little

73:3.en: Half of it - or subtract from it a little

73:4.ar: أَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَرۡتِيلًا
73:4.en: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation

73:5.ar: إِنَّا سَنُلۡقِي عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلࣰ ا ثَقِيلًا
73:5.en: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word

73:6.ar: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـࣰٔ ا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا
73:6.en: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words

73:7.ar: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحࣰ ا طَوِيلࣰ ا
73:7.en: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation

73:8.ar: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلࣰ ا
73:8.en: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion

73:9.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلࣰ ا
73:9.en: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs

73:10.ar: وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرࣰ ا جَمِيلࣰ ا
73:10.en: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance

73:11.ar: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا
73:11.en: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little

73:12.ar: إِنَّ لَدَيۡنَآ أَنكَالࣰ ا وَجَحِيمࣰ ا
73:12.en: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

73:13.ar: وَطَعَامࣰ ا ذَا غُصَّةࣲ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمࣰ ا
73:13.en: And food that chokes and a painful punishment

73:14.ar: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبࣰ ا مَّهِيلًا
73:14.en: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down

73:15.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ رَسُولࣰ ا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ رَسُولࣰ ا
73:15.en: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger

73:16.ar: فَعَصَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ أَخۡذࣰ ا وَبِيلࣰ ا
73:16.en: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure

73:17.ar: فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمࣰ ا يَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنَ شِيبًا
73:17.en: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired

73:18.ar: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرُۢ بِهِۦۚ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَفۡعُولًا
73:18.en: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled

73:19.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةࣱۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
73:19.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way

73:20.ar: ۞إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةࣱ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنࣰ اۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرࣲ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرࣰ ا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرࣰ اۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمُۢ
73:20.en: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

74:1.en: O you who covers himself [with a garment]

74:6.en: And do not confer favor to acquire more

74:7.en: But for your Lord be patient

74:8.en: And when the trumpet is blown

74:9.en: That Day will be a difficult day

74:11.en: Leave Me with the one I created alone

74:12.ar: وَجَعَلۡتُ لَهُۥ مَالࣰ ا مَّمۡدُودࣰ ا
74:12.en: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

74:14.en: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life]

74:15.en: Then he desires that I should add more

74:16.ar: كَلَّآۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِأٓيَٰتِنَا عَنِيدࣰ ا
74:16.en: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate

74:17.en: I will cover him with arduous torment

74:19.en: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated

74:20.en: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated

74:23.en: Then he turned back and was arrogant

74:24.ar: فَقَالَ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرࣱ يُؤۡثَرُ
74:24.en: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others]

74:25.en: This is not but the word of a human being

74:26.en: I will drive him into Saqar

74:27.en: And what can make you know what is Saqar

74:28.en: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned]

74:31.ar: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةࣰۖ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا عِدَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسۡتَيۡقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَيَزۡدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنࣰ ا وَلَا يَرۡتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضࣱ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡبَشَرِ
74:31.en: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity

74:33.en: And [by] the night when it departs

74:34.en: And [by] the morning when it brightens

74:35.en: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]

74:37.ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوۡ يَتَأَخَّرَ
74:37.en: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind

74:38.en: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained

74:39.en: Except the companions of the right

74:40.en: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

74:42.en: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar

74:43.en: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed

74:44.en: Nor did we used to feed the poor

74:45.en: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it]

74:46.en: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

74:47.en: Until there came to us the certainty

74:48.en: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors

74:49.en: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away

74:50.en: As if they were alarmed donkeys

74:52.ar: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُؤۡتَىٰ صُحُفࣰ ا مُّنَشَّرَةࣰ‏
74:52.en: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about

74:53.en: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter

74:54.en: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder

74:55.en: Then whoever wills will remember it

74:56.ar: وَمَا يَذۡكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ أَهۡلُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَأَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِ
74:56.en: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness

75:1.en: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

75:2.en: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection]

75:3.en: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones

75:4.ar: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُۥ
75:4.en: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips

75:5.en: But man desires to continue in sin

75:6.en: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection

75:9.en: And the sun and the moon are joined

75:10.en: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape

75:12.en: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence

75:13.ar: يُنَبَّؤُاْ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
75:13.en: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back

75:14.en: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness

75:15.en: Even if he presents his excuses

75:16.ar: لَا تُحَرِّكۡ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعۡجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
75:16.en: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an

75:17.en: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation

75:18.en: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation

75:19.en: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you]

75:20.en: No! But you love the immediate

75:22.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant

75:24.en: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted

75:25.en: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking

75:26.en: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones

75:27.en: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]

75:28.en: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation

75:29.en: And the leg is wound about the leg

75:30.en: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession

75:31.en: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed

75:32.en: But [instead], he denied and turned away

75:33.en: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride]

75:35.en: Then woe to you, and woe

75:36.en: Does man think that he will be left neglected

75:37.ar: أَلَمۡ يَكُ نُطۡفَةࣰ مِّن مَّنِيࣲّ يُمۡنَىٰ
75:37.en: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted

75:38.en: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

75:39.en: And made of him two mates, the male and the female

75:40.ar: أَلَيۡسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ
75:40.en: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead

0Tw2cxEhI2w.speaker: adnan
0Tw2cxEhI2w.speaker_note: his A Juz A Day series; welcomes viewers and teaches throughout in his own voice
0Tw2cxEhI2w.title: A Juz A Day: 29th Juz - The Hereafter is Imminent
0Tw2cxEhI2w.one_line: Al-Mulk through Al-Qiyamah: the Hereafter is closer than we think, and inviting others to Allah is a shared duty that needs patience and night prayer.
0Tw2cxEhI2w.summary: He names two threads running through the 29th juz: the Hereafter is imminent, and inviting people to Islam is a binding responsibility that every believer now shares with the Prophet. Al-Mulk shows a flawless creation designed to decline so we remember the Judgment, tests us by the quality rather than the quantity of deeds, and makes clear that everyone in the fire received the message and rejected it. It also models dawah that appeals to reason and to the heart. Al-Qalam repeatedly tells the Prophet to be patient, play the long game, and not compromise on fundamentals, with the greedy owners of the garden and Yunus as warnings. Al-Haqqah and Al-Maarij paint the records given in the right and left hands, and he notes that failing to encourage feeding the poor is listed beside disbelief. Consistent prayer, he argues, brings consistency to life so believers are not thrown by good or bad. Nuh's own account of his dawah, the jinn who listened unseen, and the commands of Al-Muzzammil and Al-Muddaththir teach that spiritual connection through night prayer must come before preaching, that you step out of your comfort zone, and that you do your part while Allah handles the results.

outline.heading: Opening
Two themes: the Hereafter is imminent and dawah is our duty
outline.gist: Eleven mostly Makkan surahs; the Prophet carried the duty of inviting to Islam best, and after him it falls on all of us.

outline.heading: The virtue of Al-Mulk
outline.gist: The Prophet taught it be recited before sleep; it protects from the punishment of the grave and intercedes on the Day of Judgment.

outline.heading: A flawless creation, with decline by design
outline.gist: Look again and again and you find no flaw; ageing and decline are intended so we realize creation will end and we will be held to account.

outline.heading: Best in deeds, not most in deeds
outline.gist: Allah created life and death to test who is best in deeds: quality matters more than quantity.

outline.heading: Did no warner come to you?
outline.gist: Hell roars and boils over, and every group thrown in admits a warner came and they called him a liar; had they listened and reasoned they would not be there.

outline.heading: No one enters hell without receiving the message
outline.gist: Polytheist, agnostic or atheist, those in the fire all rejected the message; those it never reached will be tested on the Day of Judgment.

outline.heading: He knows what is in the hearts
outline.gist: Those in awe of their unseen Lord are forgiven; how could the Creator not know His creation? A verse worth keeping in front of you.

outline.heading: The smoothed earth and the birds held aloft
outline.gist: The earth is made easy for us to live on but is not forever; only the Most Compassionate holds the birds in the sky.

outline.heading: Dawah to the mind: who provides if He withholds?
outline.gist: When Allah puts something out of reach no one can bring it, as the pandemic showed; when He gives, no one can stop it.

outline.heading: Dawah to the heart: hearing, sight and intellect
outline.gist: Allah appeals to our faculties and gratitude, then warns of the faces that darken when the torment draws near.

outline.heading: If your water sank into the earth
outline.gist: Our power is fractional and on loan from Allah, which is why we submit to Him and invite others to do so.

outline.heading: Al-Qalam: be patient and play the long game
outline.gist: A recurring Quranic message to the Prophet and to us: do not give up on people or on our own struggles.

outline.heading: By the Pen: destined to be the final prophet
outline.gist: The Pen wrote all destiny before creation; the Prophet's role and his outstanding character were written and cannot be taken from him.

outline.heading: No compromise on the fundamentals
outline.gist: The Prophet compromised on terms at Hudaybiyyah for peace, but never on the principles of the deen.

outline.heading: The owners of the garden
outline.gist: They swore to harvest everything without saying in sha Allah and to keep the poor out, then found their garden burnt to ashes.

outline.heading: How a believer responds to loss
outline.gist: Unlike their panic and mutual blame, a believer says alhamdulillah whether given or denied, knowing it is decreed.

outline.heading: What is the basis of your morality?
outline.gist: Quraysh are asked whether they have a scripture or a binding promise from Allah that guarantees them whatever they choose.

outline.heading: The day the shin is bared
outline.gist: Those who refused to prostrate when able will be unable to on that day, separating believers from rejecters; he affirms the attribute without asking how.

outline.heading: Do not be like the man of the whale
outline.gist: Yunus left his people before permission; the Prophet is told not to give up on his, since a happy ending is possible.

outline.heading: Al-Haqqah: the inevitable hour, and Thamud and Ad
outline.gist: The surah names the event and asks what will make you comprehend it, then recounts the blast and the seven-night wind.

outline.heading: Pharaoh, Lut's cities and the ark of Nuh
outline.gist: The history lesson is for attentive ears: the punishment that wiped out earlier nations can fall on anyone, and the hereafter is worse.

outline.heading: The trumpet, the crushed earth and the throne
outline.gist: Earth and mountains are flattened, the sky is torn, and eight angels bear the throne as all secrets are exposed.

outline.heading: Here, read my record: the right hand
outline.gist: The joyful believer knew he would face his reckoning and now enjoys a lofty garden with fruit within reach.

outline.heading: The left hand: seize him, he did not urge feeding the poor
outline.gist: He wishes death had been the end; a group of angels shackles him because he had no faith and did not encourage feeding the poor.

outline.heading: Not a poet or fortune teller; if he had fabricated
outline.gist: The hypothetical that the Prophet would be seized if he invented anything shows his accountability is the highest, though it never happened.

outline.heading: The absolute truth: glorify your Lord
outline.gist: The surah ends where it began, with the truth, and so we glorify Allah the Most Great.

outline.heading: Al-Maarij: the challenger who demanded punishment
outline.gist: The punishment will not be averted; it comes from the Lord of the ascending ways on a day that feels fifty thousand years long.

outline.heading: Beautiful patience
outline.gist: Ignore those trying to provoke; they see the day as far, believers see it as inevitable.

outline.heading: Friendships removed: ransoming one's family
outline.gist: The criminal would hand over spouse, children, siblings and clan to save himself, but faces a flame that strips the scalp.

outline.heading: Humans created anxious
outline.gist: People panic when hit by evil and hoard when touched by good.

outline.heading: Consistent prayer brings a consistent life
outline.gist: Those steady in their salah stay calm in good and bad times instead of swinging between highs and lows.

outline.heading: The rest of the believers' traits
outline.gist: A known share for the poor, fear of their Lord, chastity, keeping trusts, and the courage to give honest testimony; faith brings out the best of human nature.

outline.heading: Nuh tells his own story: fingers in their ears
outline.gist: Told from Nuh's point of view, he called them day and night and they stuffed their ears and covered their faces, ruder than someone on their phone.

outline.heading: Seek forgiveness and receive rain, wealth and children
outline.gist: Nuh appealed to reason and emotion: forgiveness brings worldly good too, and the Creator who made you in stages and grows you like plants will bring you back.

outline.heading: Even Nuh had a limit
outline.gist: After long patience he prayed against them and they were wiped out; the Prophet is told not to give up on his people yet.

outline.heading: Al-Jinn: listeners you never knew about
outline.gist: A group of jinn heard the Quran, believed and returned to their people; the repeated formula ties the whole surah to what was revealed about them.

outline.heading: Do your job and Allah takes care of the results
outline.gist: The Prophet did not know the jinn heard his Fajr recitation and set off a chain of conversions, so never lose hope.

outline.heading: They crowded to hear; I only convey
outline.gist: The jinn nearly tripped over each other listening; the Prophet declares he has no power to harm or benefit and does not know when the promise comes.

outline.heading: Al-Muzzammil: you wrapped in your cloak, stand at night
outline.gist: After the first revelation the Prophet asked to be covered; he is now told to pray much of the night and recite slowly before a heavy word is sent.

outline.heading: Spirituality before preaching
outline.gist: Night prayer makes the deepest impression; that connection gives the strength to endure insults, ignore them graciously and play the long game.

outline.heading: A day that turns children's hair grey
outline.gist: As Pharaoh was punished for disobeying his messenger, how will deniers protect themselves on such a day?

outline.heading: Recite what is easy and lend Allah a good loan
outline.gist: Allowance is made for tiredness, travel and battle, but keep the night prayer, pay zakat and give, as Allah repays and multiplies it.

outline.heading: Al-Muddaththir: arise and warn
outline.gist: Break out of your shell and comfort zone to give dawah, keep pure, and do not do a favour expecting more in return.

outline.heading: The chief of Quraysh who contemplated
outline.gist: A powerful, wealthy leader thought hard, frowned and finally called the Quran ancient magic, the words of a man.

outline.heading: Manufacturing a label to dismiss the Quran
outline.gist: He knew it was the truth but would not give up his seat of power; his talking points became Quraysh's, and his acceptance could have brought most of them.

outline.heading: Every soul is hostage to what it earned
outline.gist: Choices have consequences; only the people of the right are free because their deeds were good.

outline.heading: What landed you in hell? No prayer, no feeding the poor
outline.gist: Feeding the poor appears again as the second reason, after not praying, along with indulging in falsehood and denying the Judgment.

outline.heading: A reminder for whoever wills
outline.gist: A person must seek guidance and Allah gives it; He alone is worthy to be feared and to forgive.

outline.heading: Al-Qiyamah: restoring even the fingertips
outline.gist: Allah can reassemble bones down to the fingertips that uniquely identify each person; the sun and moon will be joined.

outline.heading: No escape: the soul testifies against itself
outline.gist: Each person is told what he sent forth and left behind, and his own self bears witness.

outline.heading: Do not rush your tongue with the Quran
outline.gist: A tangent reassuring the Prophet he will retain the revelation, teaching him how to learn as well as what to learn.

outline.heading: Left without purpose?
outline.gist: The One who made us from a drop and shaped male and female can bring the dead back, so life has a purpose: worship.

outline.heading: Outro

QfqJzQzsuNM.speaker: adnan
QfqJzQzsuNM.speaker_note: his Ramadan night series at MWN; refers to himself by name and to his own children
QfqJzQzsuNM.title: Ramadan 2026 Night 28 - Quranic Themes: Insights
QfqJzQzsuNM.one_line: Insight as seeing past appearances: man is a witness against himself (75:14-15), every soul knows what it brought (81:14), and bystanders are not innocent (85:7).
QfqJzQzsuNM.summary: He defines insight as seeing what lies beneath surfaces and argues that losing it means losing everything. In an age of cosmetic surgery and AI fakes the eyes are easily fooled, but the heart is not: gut feelings are not proof, yet should never be ignored, and many great scholars were blind yet saw deeply. Insight is strong in youth and either sharpens or dulls with age; without it people choose ruinous spouses or, worst of all, arrive on Judgement Day sure they did well, the greatest losers of 18:103-104. From al-Qiyamah he shows that doubts about resurrection mask a wish to follow desire, while 75:14-15 says every person is a witness to himself despite his excuses. We can fool everyone, even ourselves for a while, but not Allah, just as parents see through a child's lies. At-Takwir's scenes of cosmic collapse end with every soul knowing what it has brought, so he urges people to level with themselves now and ask for mercy like Yusuf's brothers with their poor goods, since no one else really cares. Finally al-Buruj's people of the ditch include those who sat and watched: silence before oppression is a choice that will be answered for.

outline.heading: Sight versus insight
outline.gist: Eyes see packaging and masks; insight sees what is inside and what really happened.

outline.heading: Lose insight and you lose everything
outline.gist: Eyes are fooled by any magician, but looking with the eyes of the heart always finds the way back to what is right.

outline.heading: An age of optical illusions
outline.gist: Cosmetic surgery remakes people and AI will make every photo and video worthless as evidence until verified, yet the heart still senses when something is wrong.

outline.heading: Do not ignore your gut
outline.gist: Intuition is not proof and should not be acted on alone, but it is given for a reason and should be heard and honed.

outline.heading: Blind scholars and blind hearts
outline.gist: Countless scholars were born blind yet had extraordinary insight into revelation and the seerah; it is hearts that go blind, not eyes.

outline.heading: Healthy bodies without insight
outline.gist: Some people lecture on morality with no insight into the state of their own lives and families.

outline.heading: Insight and choosing a spouse
outline.gist: The young see clearly, but insight sharpens or dulls with age; a woman blind to a harmful man or a man losing his family over a bad match shows desire overriding insight.

outline.heading: 18:103-104: the greatest losers
outline.gist: Self-honesty keeps you from drifting unaware; the biggest losers are those who thought they were doing well and arrive expecting approval.

outline.heading: His friend who always aced the exam
outline.gist: A friend left every exam certain he had done well and scored half; over-optimism without honest self-assessment costs dearly.

outline.heading: 75:3-12: the real reason for denial
outline.gist: Man claims Allah cannot reassemble his bones, but the real issue is wanting an excuse to follow desire guilt-free; on that day he will ask where to flee.

outline.heading: 75:14-15: a witness against himself
outline.gist: Whatever excuses he offers, man knows exactly why he did what he did; he can fool spouse, parents and community, even himself, but not Allah.

outline.heading: An inner compass
outline.gist: Imagine not knowing your own motives; Allah gave a compass that always tells you whether you were selfish, petty or sincere.

outline.heading: Admit it to yourself
outline.gist: 75:13 says man will be told all he did, though he does not need telling; you need not confess to others, but you must be honest with yourself.

outline.heading: Children's lies and our excuses to Allah
outline.gist: Parents see straight through a child's lies, and we do the same with Allah; raising children is the closest thing we have to understanding that relationship.

outline.heading: 81:1-4: the cosmos unravels
outline.gist: The sun wound into a ball, stars falling to dust, mountains moved like powder and pregnant animals abandoned.

outline.heading: 81:5: the animals gathered
outline.gist: Every creature is a nation like us and will be brought back, so treat animals as neighbours and partners on earth.

outline.heading: 81:6-7: seas ablaze and souls paired
outline.gist: Oceans catch fire, and each person is joined with those most like them; no one stands alone.

outline.heading: 81:8-11: the buried girl is asked
outline.gist: Murdered children will be asked for what sin they were killed, including babies buried under their bombed homes; records are spread and the sky stripped away.

outline.heading: 81:12-14: every soul knows what it brought
outline.gist: Hell is kindled and Paradise brought near, and every soul knows exactly what it carries.

outline.heading: Level with yourself now
outline.gist: Use the insight you already have to admit who you are without decoration; that honesty is the launching pad for change.

outline.heading: A dua that relies on mercy alone
outline.gist: In the last nights, ask Allah as Yusuf's brothers asked with their worthless goods: we bring little, so be charitable to us.

outline.heading: No one else really cares
outline.gist: The social web of opinions and status means nothing; people will not ask after you, and the only one who has ever truly cared is Allah.

outline.heading: Standing amid it all, knowing
outline.gist: As creation is remade you will know what you brought; leveling with yourself now spares you the greatest disappointment.

outline.heading: Interlude
The people of the ditch
outline.gist: A king burned believers one by one in a fiery trench for refusing to give up their faith, and they stood firm.

outline.heading: Oaths by the witness and the witnessed
outline.gist: Allah swears by the constellations, the promised day and every witness and thing witnessed before cursing the people of the ditch.

outline.heading: Three groups at the trench
outline.gist: The cursed are not only those who dug it; there were the believers, the criminals and a third group who sat and watched.

outline.heading: The silent majority
outline.gist: The neutral onlookers who see and have opinions but say nothing let a harmful minority set the norm; he calls them the biggest evil.

outline.heading: Doing nothing is a choice
outline.gist: The idea that it is not your problem is foreign to Islam; standing by while people are stripped of rights is a decision.

outline.heading: The eldest who 'didn't do anything'
outline.gist: Parents blame the eldest when the younger ones wreck the house; before Allah, having done nothing is exactly the charge.

outline.heading: Witnesses will answer
outline.gist: Those who watched oppression and went to sleep knew what they could have done; you would never accept that excuse if you were the one under fire.

wrHlbavpTvw.speaker: adnan
wrHlbavpTvw.speaker_note: leads the night prayer and gives the reminder between rakaat; part of his Ramadan 2026 series
wrHlbavpTvw.title: Ramadan 2026, Night 29: Ninth Night of Tahajjud
wrHlbavpTvw.one_line: Between rakaat on the 29th night: seek forgiveness before dawn, never feel you have done enough, and carry that humility beyond Ramadan.
wrHlbavpTvw.summary: On the twenty-ninth night of Ramadan 2026, Sh. Adnan gives one short reminder between rakaat. As the month closes, he tells people not to expect to carry all of Ramadan forward, because that will not happen, but to keep some of it, such as a set time to rise and pray at night. He then reflects on how Allah describes the righteous as people who sleep little at night and seek forgiveness before dawn, and who are named together as patient, truthful, devout, generous and seeking forgiveness in the pre-dawn hours. The immediate lesson is to use the last third of the night, the prime time for asking forgiveness. The deeper lesson is the mindset behind it: people with this much worship are not made arrogant by it, do not see themselves as better than other Muslims, and never think they have done enough. That humility and constant asking for forgiveness, he says, is the one thing he hopes everyone takes out of Ramadan, and he closes the reminder with the prophetic dua of one who admits he has wronged himself greatly and asks Allah alone to forgive him.
